# 2 Baruch Chapter 52 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And I answered and said: "How can it be that those who do good works will see that the reward of their works is not in vain?"

**2** "And moreover, how will this transformation of which you speak to me come to pass?"

**3** And he answered and said to me: "Those who are in darkness will pass away, and those who are in light will endure."

**4** "For as many as have been saved by their works will return and not be disquieted; and they will not be ashamed on account of their works."

**5** "But those who have neglected the law and who have not heard wisdom and who have not received understanding — those shall know the torment of the hour."

**6** "For they shall see those who are superior to them, and they shall not be equal to them; and they shall receive shameful things, that they may be tormented."

**7** "For those who were saved in that day will enter into the joy of their king, and they will be like unto angels in appearance."

**8** "But those who were not saved will depart in confusion, and they will be ashamed; for a law will be judgment upon them, and a deed will stand as a witness."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
